name: dc-bocage-coop-rec
description: Desert Combat Bocage co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only: DC's overlay of the vanilla level (vanilla's AI data), the co-op layer with a Harrier (AV-8B, team 2) that resolves. Bocage Day 2 and Day 3 name `Av8B`, which DC never creates, so they spawn none. Also AH-6/SA-342G/UH-60, F-15C/MiG-29/Su-25, T-72/M1A1, BMP-2/M2A3, BRDM-2/Humvee, MLRS/BM-21, M-109/M-1974. Needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client DesertCombat`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Let it play two rounds, then `lab.py stop`.
